title: Run-question answers are filed in adj under the owner setting
lead: *Proposed.* Owner decision 2026-11-12 (adj 327, `owner.filing-run-answers` = run-answers): the daemon resolves the owner for `run.answer` from the owner setting, and filing an answer in adj is on by default when an owner is known, with ctrl+a in the run pane as the per-session off switch. Ledger answers (`relayanswer`) do not change in this slice.
findings_note: S314 (2026-11-12) files spec-check answers in adj under the owner setting (`ork settings set --owner`, adj 322, 323); run-question answers (ctrl+a, `FileAnswer`) still need `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* S314 added the global owner setting for spec-check answers. A run question the owner answers in the run pane or with `ork answer` is filed in adj only when `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` is set in the daemon's environment, so most owner answers to run questions never reach the decision log. The implementer re-anchors the paths after S314 lands: the run pane's ctrl+a toggle (`internal/tui/pane.go`), `FileAnswer` and the `run.answer` handler (`internal/daemon/runs.go`).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- With the owner setting `Jon` and no `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, `run.answer` on a question with a decision key files a decided adj record by Jon.
- With no owner setting and no `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, `run.answer` files nothing, as today.
- ctrl+a in the run pane turns filing off for the session; the next answer files nothing.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Start after S314 lands; re-anchor the files.
2. Resolve the owner for `run.answer` from the owner setting, then `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`.
3. Default filing on when an owner is known; ctrl+a turns it off for the session.
4. Docs (*proposed*): `docs/design.md`, `docs/dashboard.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
